annotations.title: Total U.S. duty for an HTS line and a country of origin

description: Adds up the U.S. import duty on one 8- or 10-digit HTS line for goods of one country of origin under the current HTS revision: the column 1 (or column 2) rate plus the Chapter 99 additional duties in force that this tool models (Section 232 actions on metals, vehicles and other products, the Section 301 actions on China, Brazil and the 60 economies of the forced-labor action, and the Section 338 duties on Canada). Returns each layer with its Chapter 99 heading, rate and U.S. note, the exemptions it found, the total, the assumptions it made with what changes if an assumption is wrong, measures that are printed in the schedule but not in force, and what is not covered (for example antidumping and countervailing duties). When a question cannot be settled from the code and origin, the result says so and gives a range.

ad_valorem_equivalent_pct.description: Optional: for a line with a specific or compound column 1 rate, the duty payable divided by the customs value, in percent. Needed only when the result asks for it.

answers.description: Optional answers to the questions a previous result listed under "assumptions", by id, e.g. {"preference": true}.

customs_value_usd.description: Optional customs value in U.S. dollars; when given and the total is a percentage, an estimated duty amount is returned.

detail.description: "full" adds the complete text of each Chapter 99 heading.

hts_code.description: HTS number with 8 or 10 digits, dotted or not, e.g. "6109.10.00" or "8471.30.01.00". Use hts_search to find a code from product words.

origin.description: Country of origin of the goods: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "CN") or English name (e.g. "Vietnam"). For the European Union name the member state.
